---
title: "Stream fishes of Pine Creek"
---

Explore the sampling sites in the Pine Creek watershed (Allegheny County, PA).
Click a purple dot to learn about a site. Use the layer button (top right of the map) to turn streams and roads on or off.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(readxl)

# ---- 1. Your site table (edit data/sites.xlsx, then rebuild the site) ----
sites <- read_excel("data/sites.xlsx")
nm <- names(sites)

# Find the columns by name (any capitalization)
find_col <- function(pattern) { m <- grep(pattern, nm, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE); if (length(m)) m[1] else NA }
lat_col    <- find_col("lat")
lon_col    <- find_col("lon")
name_col   <- find_col("site.?name|^name$")
status_col <- find_col("status|sampled")
show_col   <- find_col("show")      # optional: a "Show on website" column with Yes/No

if (is.na(lat_col) || is.na(lon_col)) stop("data/sites.xlsx needs latitude and longitude columns")

sites$lat <- as.numeric(sites[[lat_col]])
sites$lon <- -abs(as.numeric(sites[[lon_col]]))
sites <- sites[!is.na(sites$lat) & !is.na(sites$lon), ]
if (!is.na(show_col)) sites <- sites[tolower(trimws(as.character(sites[[show_col]]))) %in% c("yes", "y", "true", "1"), ]

sites$label <- if (!is.na(name_col)) as.character(sites[[name_col]]) else paste("Site", seq_len(nrow(sites)))
sites$popup <- paste0("<b>", sites$label, "</b>",
                      if (!is.na(status_col)) paste0("<br>Sampled: ", sites[[status_col]]) else "")

# ---- 2. Map layers (exported from R as geojson) ----
ws        <- st_read("data/watershed.geojson", quiet = TRUE)
streams   <- st_read("data/streams_sampleable.geojson", quiet = TRUE)
streams_a <- st_read("data/streams_all.geojson", quiet = TRUE)
roads     <- st_read("data/roads.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

# ---- 3. Map ----
leaflet(sites, height = 650) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") |>
  addPolylines(data = streams_a, color = "#00BFFF", weight = 1.5, group = "All streams") |>
  addPolylines(data = roads, color = "yellow", weight = 1, group = "Roads") |>
  addPolylines(data = streams, color = "#39FF14", weight = 3, opacity = 0.7,
               group = "Sampleable streams") |>
  addPolygons(data = ws, fill = FALSE, color = "white", weight = 3, group = "Watershed boundary") |>
  addCircleMarkers(~lon, ~lat, radius = 8, color = "white", weight = 2,
                   fillColor = "#BF00FF", fillOpacity = 1,
                   label = ~label, popup = ~popup, group = "Sampling sites") |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Sampling sites", "Sampleable streams", "All streams", "Roads", "Watershed boundary"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE)) |>
  hideGroup(c("Roads", "All streams"))
```

*Site locations are approximate. Please respect private property and local regulations.*
